West Bengal Minister Oversees Destruction of Seized Cough Syrup

West Bengal Leader of the Opposition Suvendu Adhikari oversaw the destruction of over 2 lakh bottles of seized cough syrup in West Bengal. The destruction was carried out using a road roller. The seized cough syrup is believed to be intended for illegal sale and distribution.
